name: paper-distill
description: Codex local plugin manifest for the repository-root Paper Distill checkout.

interface.shortDescription: Discover, capture, search, and maintain a qmd-backed research vault.
interface.longDescription: Paper Distill v3 stages candidate papers for human approval, captures approved arXiv source material into qmd-backed vault notes, exposes an agent-facing capability index, reads through QMD CLI query/get, and writes canonical distillations through Python MCP tools with explicit QMD refresh guidance.
defaultPrompt: Discover new VLA papers and stage them in my inbox.
Ingest approved arXiv papers into qmd-backed source notes.
Search my v3 vault with QMD, then tell me the next maintenance step.
